_doc: Copy to media/config.json (gitignored) and edit. 'src' = root folder of your local renders. Each rule maps a path pattern under src to one manifest item; {id} = drill id (no slash), * = any text without slash, a trailing / = a folder of PNG frames. storage 'r2' = published to Cloudflare R2 by publish.py; 'local' = tracked by sha256 only, never uploaded (keep on your disk + off-site backup). theme = the theme file the variant was rendered with (its sha256 is recorded). The rules below follow tools/hiplab-render's batch layout; change them to match your folders and check with: py media/tools/ingest.py --version 0.1.0 --dry-run

specOverrides._doc: drill id -> spec file actually rendered, when it is not drill-anim/specs/<id>.js (e.g. an r2 revision)
